stories.title: Creation of the Heavens and Earth
stories.summary: God speaks light, sky, land, sea, plants, sun, moon, birds, fish, animals, and humankind into being over six days and rests on the seventh.

stories.title: The Fall
stories.summary: The serpent tempts Eve and Adam to eat from the tree of knowledge; they are cast out of Eden and guarded by cherubim.

stories.title: Cain and Abel
stories.summary: Two brothers offer gifts; the Lord favors Abel's, envies Cain's, and Cain slays his brother in the field.

stories.title: Noah and the Flood
stories.summary: Noah builds an ark at God's command, saves his family and pairs of every creature, and is blessed after the waters recede.

stories.title: Abraham's Call
stories.summary: God promises Abram land, descendants, and blessing; he journeys to Canaan and pitches tents at Shechem, Bethel, and Ai.

stories.title: Abraham Intercedes for Sodom
stories.summary: Abraham bargains with God to spare the city if righteous ones are found within it.

stories.title: Joseph's Rise and Reconciliation
stories.summary: A favored son is sold into slavery, rises to rule Egypt during famine, and forgives his brothers who once betrayed him.

stories.title: Exodus from Egypt
stories.summary: Moses leads Israel out of bondage through ten plagues, a sea that swallows Pharaoh's army, and a pillar of cloud and fire.

stories.title: The Ten Commandments
stories.summary: God speaks ten words of law to Moses at Sinai, carved on stone tablets for all the people.

stories.title: Shema: Love the Lord
stories.summary: Moses calls Israel to love the Lord with all heart, soul, and strength, and to teach these words to their children.

stories.title: Ruth's Devotion
stories.summary: A Moabite widow clings to Naomi's God, gleans in the fields of Boaz, and becomes an ancestor of David.

stories.title: David and Goliath
stories.summary: A young shepherd strikes down the Philistine giant with a single stone and a sling.

stories.title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
stories.summary: A psalm of trust in God's green pastures, still waters, and eternal house.

stories.title: The Servant's Song
stories.summary: A prophetic vision of a gentle servant who brings justice without breaking a bruised reed.

stories.title: The Baptism of Jesus
stories.summary: John baptizes Jesus in the Jordan; the heavens open and the Spirit descends like a dove.

stories.title: Parables of the Kingdom
stories.summary: Jesus tells of a pearl of great price and a hidden treasure worth selling everything to obtain.

stories.title: The Good Samaritan
stories.summary: A wounded man is rescued by a despised neighbor, teaching that love of neighbor has no borders.

stories.title: Feeding the Five Thousand
stories.summary: Jesus multiplies five loaves and two fish to feed a vast crowd in a desert place.

stories.title: The Crucifixion
stories.summary: Jesus is lifted up on a wooden beam; darkness falls, a spear flows with blood and water, and a tomb is sealed.

stories.title: The Resurrection
stories.summary: Mary finds the tomb empty and meets the risen Lord, who breathes peace on his frightened friends.

stories.title: Paul's Conversion
stories.summary: A persecutor of the way is struck blind on the road to Damascus and becomes an apostle to the nations.

stories.title: A New Heaven and a New Earth
stories.summary: John sees a holy city descending, where God wipes away every tear and death is no more.
